cds-e1-profile-card.reply:
Here's the profile card:

```jsx
import { Avatar, Text, ListCell, VStack, HStack } from '@coinbase/cds-web';

function ProfileCard({ user, onAccountSettings, onNotifications, onSignOut }) {
  return (
    <VStack borderRadius="roundedLarge" background="bgPrimary" padding={3} gap={2}>
      <HStack gap={2} alignItems="center">
        <Avatar src={user.avatarUrl} name={user.displayName} size="m" />
        <VStack gap={0}>
          <Text font="title3">{user.displayName}</Text>
          <Text font="body" color="fgMuted">{user.email}</Text>
        </VStack>
      </HStack>
      <VStack>
        <ListCell title="Account settings" accessory="arrow" onPress={onAccountSettings} />
        <ListCell title="Notifications" accessory="arrow" onPress={onNotifications} />
        <ListCell title="Sign out" accessory="arrow" onPress={onSignOut} />
      </VStack>
    </VStack>
  );
}

export default ProfileCard;
```

This uses Avatar for the photo, ListCell rows with the arrow accessory for the three settings items, fgMuted for the email, generic Text with the font prop throughout, a token-based borderRadius, and VStack/HStack for layout — no raw colors or pixel values anywhere, and every import is a top-level CDS export.
